college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: Africana studies is an interdisciplinary field of study devoted to the critical and systematic examination of the cultural, political, social, economic, and historical experiences of Africans, African Americans throughout the hemisphere, and peoples of African descent around the world. Students are able to choose focused concentrations in African American or Africa studies.
